name: Umami
description: Umami counts the visits of your websites with no cookies and shows them on a clean dashboard. For site owners who want simple analytics that respects privacy.
licence_note: Free to self-host, also for commercial use.
whats_new: The first version of the template.
first_steps: Sign in as admin with the password in the environment variable ADMIN_PASSWORD (Environment, Reveal). FlyWP replaces the default password of Umami at the first start. Change the password in Umami: a change of the variable later does not change it.
